installation.reason: Migrated GS certification binding for the gs-scheme-authorization use case, plus an experimental GS-mark credential for one unit and an experimental product passport shaped after the ESPR DPP whose GS-mark entry is supported by that credential (not ESPR conformance). The gate 0-6 evaluators for the competence-and-scheme-permission and gs-certified-product routes, their coverage and the certificate's required studies (type examination and factory inspection) are implemented; statutory GS routes, application assessments and conformity rules are not.

carrierAndSchema.statusListCarrier: BitstringStatusListCredential with the VCDM 2.0 context only
carrierAndSchema.nativeRepresentation: A JSON-LD simplification of a GS certificate; no native scheme document is carried

cardinality.authorizingReferenceSelection: by-declared-reference-type-per-route-half; resolved credential type must match (else contradicted); several of one type not_established
cardinality.selectedClaims: the certification statement at /credentialSubject/certification; for a GS-mark credential its marking at /credentialSubject/marking; for a product passport only the GS-mark entry at /credentialSubject/complianceInformation/gsMark (other passport sections have no interpretation in this binding)

discoveryAndIntegrity.independentGrantBinding: unsupported: authority is recognized only through termsOfUse authorizationCredential references on the credential chain

rules: The accreditation (competence) and the scheme authorization each name the certification body issuing the certificate.
The accreditation permits certifying products; the scheme authorization permits awarding the GS mark.
The accreditation issuer is anchored for accrediting certification bodies; the scheme authorization issuer for authorizing GS certification.
Both grants were in force at the certificate's activity time.

A certificate needs a type examination of its model covering its category and standards, and a factory inspection of its manufacturer; each passed, precedes the certification and is issued under an anchored accreditation of its issuer that permits the activity (type examination: testing, under an issuer anchored for accrediting testing laboratories; factory inspection: certification, which includes factory inspection, under an issuer anchored for accrediting certification bodies) and was in force at the study.

A GS-mark credential's marking must name the credential's own model, and needs a GS certificate that names the credential issuer as manufacturer, certifies that model, was in force when the unit was placed on the market and itself holds the complete route.

A product passport is issued by the responsible economic operator it names. Its GS-mark entry must name the passport's model and is supported by exactly one cited GS-mark credential for the same unit, from the same issuer and for the same model, which itself holds its complete route.

scopeAndMapping.standardRule: one competence record must cover the category and every certified standard; a record listing standards against a certification naming none is not_established (no empty-array bypass)
scopeAndMapping.schemeRule: one scheme record must cover the category

protectionTimeAndResolution.statusMechanism: W3C Bitstring Status List v1.0: multibase base64url GZIP encodedList, bounded decompression

supportAndDisclosure.requiredSupport: type examination (GsTypeExaminationReference to a GsTestReport) and factory inspection (GsFactoryInspectionReference to a GsInspectionReport) of the certificate
